title: Speak Kindly to Everyone
task: Do not speak harshly or mock anyone today. Use gentle, uplifting words with family, classmates, and staff.
scripture_link: Speech that does not cause distress, is truthful, pleasant, and beneficial is the austerity of speech. (Gita 17.15)
reflection_prompt: How did speaking gently change how others responded to you today?

title: Selfless Help (Nishkama Seva)
task: Help someone today (a classmate with studies, a family member with chores, or someone on the road) without expecting anything in return or bragging about it.
scripture_link: Charity given out of duty to one who cannot repay is Sattvic. (Gita 17.20)
reflection_prompt: How did giving unconditionally make your mind feel?

title: Spend 10 Minutes in Complete Silence (Mauna)
task: Sit in a comfortable position for 10 minutes without smartphone, talking, or music. Simply observe your breath.
scripture_link: Silence of speech, self-restraint, and purity of mind are the discipline of mind. (Gita 17.16)
reflection_prompt: What thoughts popped up when everything went quiet?

title: Express Heartfelt Gratitude to Parents / Elders
task: Say a sincere 'Thank You' or touch the feet of your parents or mentors for their selfless sacrifices for your life.
scripture_link: Matru Devo Bhava, Pitru Devo Bhava (Taittiriya Upanishad)
reflection_prompt: What was their reaction and how did your relationship feel?

title: Conquer Anger: The 10-Second Pause
task: Whenever irritation or anger begins to rise today, take 10 deep breaths and do not reply until you have cooled down.
scripture_link: From anger arises delusion, from delusion loss of memory and wisdom. (Gita 2.63)
reflection_prompt: Did pausing prevent an unnecessary argument or regret?

title: Digital Fasting During Meal Time
task: Eat all your meals today with 100% awareness—no phones, no YouTube, no scrolling. Cherish each bite as Prasad.
scripture_link: Food is Brahman when consumed with gratitude and moderation. (Maitri Upanishad)
reflection_prompt: Did you enjoy your food more and feel more energized?

title: Compassion for Animals & Nature
task: Feed a stray dog, water a plant, or place a bowl of fresh water for birds on your balcony or terrace.
scripture_link: The wise look upon all living beings with an equal eye. (Gita 5.18)
reflection_prompt: How did caring for another living creature brighten your day?
